title: Cutting the letter A from folded paper
description: Four steps: a square paper with a dashed fold line, the folded paper with half of the letter A drawn on it, the half A cut out, and the opened paper showing the full letter A.

title: Cutting the letter M from folded paper
description: A folded paper with the left half of the letter M drawn along the fold, an arrow, and the opened paper with the full M and a dashed line of symmetry.

title: Lines of symmetry of B, W and H
description: Three letters, B with a dashed horizontal line, W with a dashed vertical line and H with a dashed vertical and a dashed horizontal line.

title: A pinwheel turned a quarter at a time
description: Four copies of a four-blade pinwheel with a dot on the top, right, bottom and left blade, labelled Start, 1/4 turn, 1/2 turn and 3/4 turn.

title: The letters Z and T turned
description: The letter Z at the start, after a 1/4 turn and after a 1/2 turn, and the letter T at the start and after a 1/2 turn, each with a dot and a dashed outline of the start.

title: M, S and the plus sign: which test do they pass
description: Three cards: the letter M with a dashed vertical line, the letter S with a curved arrow for a 1/2 turn, and a plus sign with dashed lines and a curved arrow for a 1/4 turn.

title: Adding triangles to a circle for a half turn and a quarter turn
description: A circle with a triangle above it, the same with a triangle added below, and the same with triangles added on the left and right, the added triangles in amber.

title: A square cut by its diagonals, two colours
description: A square cut by its diagonals into 4 triangles, top and bottom amber, left and right teal, with a dashed vertical line and a dashed horizontal line through the middle.

title: A half print of a leaf and the whole print
description: The left half of a leaf with a dashed straight edge, an arrow, and the whole leaf with the copied half in amber and a dashed line of symmetry.

title: A flower block stamped twice with a half turn
description: A square print area with a flower at the top and the same flower turned a half turn at the bottom, with a curved arrow marked 1/2 turn.

title: The chapter in three pictures
description: Three cards: the letter A with a dashed vertical line, a pinwheel with a turning arrow, and the letter H with dashed lines and a turning arrow.
